title: Final web acceptance and QA verdict
summary: The repo contains a working, validated local web app and repo-side validation assumptions were repaired, but repository-wide Swift/iOS test acceptance is blocked on this machine until the Apple Xcode license is accepted with elevated privileges.
blockers: Local Xcode license is not accepted; make/swift test commands stop with exit code 69 before executing repository tests.
required_followups: Run sudo xcodebuild -license on the local machine.
Rerun make typecheck, make test, and any desired xcodebuild coverage/host checks after the license is accepted.
Run manual browser/device sanity if release sign-off needs device confidence.
